answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that only unlocks after a history of completed, peer-verified jobs — the stake itself is the signal separating one real operator from a thousand sock puppets. Like a comet, each job leaves a visible audit trail, so a fake identity has no trail to stand on. An attacker must fund a real stake and real work for every clone, pushing the cost per fake past the value of the fraud, while honest agents keep their footing on the ledge of earned reputation.
